main_text.p: 'Hinc etiam ministeria intermedia. Exprace-dentibus omnibus cum Rom. 15. 8. inter se com-paratis.
main_text.l: Primum, regnum Dei iam iam appropinquare.
Secundū, vt ex vera resipiscentia ad illud recipiendū sint comparati.
main_text.p: Iohannis Baptistae ministerium, est ministerium intermedium, quo Christi erat praenuncius. Mat. vlt. Mar.1.1.2.3. Luc.3.4.5.6.7.8. & 2.76.77.78.De Ioan. bap.mini-sterio cap.4.

Propriae doctrinae administratio erat, quae de Christo venturo, etiam coram praesenti testimonium illustrissimum reddebat. Ioa. 1. 6. 7. 8. 9. 15. 16. 17. 18. 19. 20. 21. 22. 23. &c. 29. &c. 36. &c. & 2. 26. 29. 30. 31. 32. 33.

page.notes: Diagram brackets reconstructed from the printed braces; the margin note at right is placed beside the paragraph beginning "Iohannis Baptistae". Some words in the braces and at line ends are doubtful, notably "Euangelicae politeiae" and "contiguū".
